entity.name: Sung Hun Kwag
entity.description: Independent maintainer of RSI MetaForge Core. I build and maintain a deterministic, CPU-runnable Python research runtime for reproducible experiments in program synthesis, self-generated task search, and measured system improvement. The project is developed in public with executable tests, frozen evaluation instruments, committed result records, and explicit limitations.

projects.name: RSI MetaForge Core
projects.description: RSI MetaForge Core is an Apache-2.0-licensed, standard-library-only Python runtime for studying whether programs can propose, test, and retain measurable improvements under fixed evaluation conditions. The public repository includes 286 executable tests, quick and full-evidence GitHub Actions workflows, sealed held-out evaluations, deterministic replay checks, failure and rollback records, pre-registered predictions, and committed result documents across stack-VM, file-processing, formal-reasoning, and self-generated-task substrates. It is a bounded experimental research instrument, not a claim of general intelligence or a production code-evolution service. Funding supports maintenance, reproducible releases, faster CI, independent reproduction tooling, documentation, and broader externally designed evaluation tasks.

plans.name: Minimum sustainability grant
plans.description: A one-time minimum-denomination grant for ten months of public maintenance. Deliverables: three tagged reproducible releases; a parallelized evidence workflow; a documented external-reproduction kit; independently specified held-out evaluation packs; issue and contribution templates; and monthly public maintenance notes. Budget: USD 7,000 maintainer time, USD 1,500 CI/storage/compute, USD 1,000 benchmark and reproduction work, and USD 500 transfer, tax, and administrative reserve.
